source.label: MindAnchor values clarification protocol
source.citationPolicy: Use paraphrase and explicit uncertainty; never invent or attribute quotations.

packs.description: Clarifies the user's priorities and trade-offs without choosing on the user's behalf.

source.label: MindAnchor systems perspective protocol
source.citationPolicy: Describe causal hypotheses as hypotheses; never present an attributed quotation as evidence.

packs.description: Surfaces dependencies, feedback loops and second-order effects for comparison.

source.label: MindAnchor scientific reasoning protocol
source.citationPolicy: Separate observations from hypotheses and disclose missing evidence; do not fabricate sources or quotations.

packs.description: Separates observations, hypotheses, tests and confidence so the user can update beliefs.

source.label: MindAnchor energy and recovery protocol
source.citationPolicy: Offer non-clinical pacing options with uncertainty; never diagnose or prescribe treatment.

packs.description: Helps compare load, recovery and pacing options without making a medical claim.
